specs.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE complete, finished 16:9 LANDSCAPE full-screen game UI design image for 《交子赶工记》. This is a new page in the EXACT same visual system as reference images 1 and 2: cohesive premium Song-era Chinese handcrafted PAPERCUT DIORAMA, beautifully textured cream cardstock, visible layered cut-paper thickness, softly rounded stepped/scalloped corners, double embossed golden-ochre edges, thin jade insets, restrained Chinese cloud-scroll ornaments, soft warm directional shadows and fine paper fibers. Keep richly saturated GOLD ginkgo, JADE foliage and turquoise water, INDIGO blue roof tiles, warm honey timber cardstock, IVORY paper panels, CINNABAR red buttons. Charming cute co-op game, NOT flat vector UI, NOT simplified HTML/CSS, NOT a website, NOT a wireframe, NOT a sprite sheet, NOT multiple screens in one canvas. Every page must be immersive edge-to-edge polished game art with interface and setting together. Typography is elegant dark-brown Chinese brush calligraphy on ivory plaques, cream lettering on red main buttons, legible and carefully composed. No English explanatory text, no watermark, no browser/device. The game name is precisely “交子赶工记”. Characters stay faithful to both references: 纸团 is the cute square-headed boy wearing a folded cream paper hat, olive/cream robe with blue details; 印桃 is the cute twin-bun brown-haired girl with red ribbons and red/cream robe. Original expressive faces and natural small hands. No new playable characters. All plants are layered flat papercut leaves, no realistic grass. Full 16:9 page, no cropped labels/buttons or empty design board. The images are STYLE/CHARACTER references, do not simply reproduce their existing interface layout.
PAGE: TITLE / MAIN MENU. Make a gorgeous inviting illustrated game cover and working main-menu visual. Huge original title “交子赶工记” in confident dark-brown hand-lettered calligraphy on a thick ivory cloud-shaped layered paper sign across upper center, small cinnabar seal accent. Under the title, readable subtitle “交个纸友，一起开工”. Lush papercraft workshop courtyard fills background, golden ginkgo trees framing both sides, blue tiled roofs, turquoise stream and curved stone bridge at bottom, pale layered mountain silhouettes and light paper clouds in distance. The two main characters stand together prominently in foreground, boy on left and girl on right, cheerfully presenting ONE completed Jiaozi note between them, with coin ornament and their tiny woodcut likenesses. A nearby red seal and brush are visual props, not modern tools. Scene warm, lively and layered but title and buttons have clear visual priority. Three beautifully substantial paper menu plaques arranged vertically or as a clearly ordered central stack in lower-center: LARGE cinnabar primary button “一起开工”, second ivory/jade button “交子收藏”, third ivory/gold button “设置”. Tiny small corner back-to-desktop button “退出游戏”. Buttons must look tangible like thick die-cut paper with gold key-corner borders and soft shadows, matching reference quality. Keep generous click areas and coherent baseline. Small footer plaque “双人合作 · 同机同屏”. Make this a distinct rich title page, not the previous level-select screen.
